title: Cortex MemoryStoreRequest (DRAFT v0)
description: Canonical wire shape for POST /store on mnemos (and every alias surface: /mobile/memory). Mirrors the historical main.py:StoreRequest BaseModel but is the SINGLE source of truth per ADR-0014; main.py imports and re-types it. The keystone is `additionalProperties:false` — without it a producer could inject rogue fields (e.g. undeclared provenance metadata, hidden session links) that consumers would silently pick up. `raw_text` is the only required field; every other field is an optional provenance/routing metadata. `valid_from` is a date-time when present. Status: DRAFT; bump $id on breaking changes. Note: this is the WRITE shape; the read shape (mnemos.db:store_memory row) carries additional server-stamped fields (memory_id, content_hash, indexed_at) that are never accepted on input.

raw_text.description: The memory body. Non-empty. Whitespace-trim happens server-side; the contract is the wire shape, not the post-trim shape.

container_tag.description: Target container (alias or canonical). Server normalizes via normalize_container_tag(). Defaults to 'hermes-pending' for unscoped writes.

memory_type.description: Memory class. Defaults to 'episodic' (raw conversation). The 7-value enum covers the producer fleet: 'episodic' (turns) | 'semantic' (consolidated) | 'fact' (atomic claims) | 'raw_session' (session metadata, not body) | 'operational' (system/internal) | 'receipt' (execution-receipt mirror) | 'block' (pinned structural entries).

actor_id.description: Provenance — who is writing (e.g. user id, agent name).

actor_class.description: Provenance — what kind of writer (human | agent | system | cron | mcp-bridge).

confidence.description: Writer-supplied confidence score, 0..1. Null when the writer has no opinion.

source_provider.description: Provenance — originating system (mnemos default; fleet sets 'hermes' | 'cortex' | 'mavis' | etc.).

source_record_id.description: Id of the source record in the producer's namespace (turn id, receipt id, session message id).

source_container.description: Provenance — container the source record came from (e.g. hermes session tag).

metadata.description: Provenance — free-form caller metadata. additionalProperties: true (unlike the parent) because callers do ship opaque blobs here; the keystone still rejects UNEXPECTED TOP-LEVEL keys (which is what additionalProperties:false on the parent covers).

valid_from.description: ISO-8601 / RFC-3339 timestamp; null when unspecified.

memory_block_level.description: 0=session, 1=container, 2=memory (default). Drives block-vs-memory dispatch on the read side.

is_synthesized.description: True when this memory is a synthesis of other memories (vs. a direct write).

parent_memory_id.description: For synthesis children — the synthesized memory this one rolled up.

session_id.description: Mnemos session id when this write is part of a session (see /sessions).

promoted.description: True when this write is the result of a /promote ritual (vs. an ordinary /store). Set by the server on promote; caller-supplied true is allowed for backfill but ignored as a signal.
